blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippines ranks among the Asia-Pacific countries that could benefit from rewiring traditional supply chain networks, particularly the ongoing “China+1” shift, according to global shipping and logistics company DHL. DHL Express Asia-Pacific CEO Ken Lee said geopolitical tensions and companies’ efforts to build more resilient supply chains were increasingly reshaping trade flows […]...
